install_plan.description: Use the speech.cpp service preset after installing the managed tool-runtime binary.

services.notes: speech.cpp is managed as a service runtime so OpenAI-compatible HTTP availability is tracked separately from the managed binary (tool-runtime speech_cpp). Default bind is 127.0.0.1:8095; probe GET /health. Start with `speech serve [tts-model] [asr-model] --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8095` (models optional until a client needs them). voice-hub STT can point VOICE_HUB_STT_BASE_URL or KYBERION_SPEECH_CPP_URL at this server.
